summary: Eva Live Inc filed an 8-K reporting an October 2, 2026 securities purchase agreement with Dune Equity Holdings LLC for a 12% secured promissory note of up to $1,875,000 principal, priced at up to $1,575,000 via a $300,000 original issue discount. The first tranche of $937,500 principal was funded for $787,500, netting $747,500 after $40,000 legal fees, plus 75,000 commitment shares; a make-whole share adjustment applies below $2.86. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; monitor dilution from commitment shares and potential tranches.
